function.name: search_site_object
function.description: Search the current site search index by keyword with skip/take pagination.

skip.description: Nonnegative integer number of matches to skip, default 0.

take.description: Nonnegative integer maximum matches to return, default 20. Use an explicit small page size and increment skip to continue.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
